stations.label: 00_QUICK_CALL
stations.name: QUICK_CALL
stations.description: Send one editable prompt with arbitrary files to DeepSeek; each input is saved immediately.

stations.label: 01_YT_GRAB
stations.name: YT_GRAB
stations.description: Download YouTube transcripts (channel, playlist or video URLs) into yt_subtitles. Then asks what to look for in this channel and whether to auto-process new videos.

stations.label: 02_YT_CLEAN
stations.name: YT_CLEAN
stations.description: Clean raw transcripts into readable notes (local Python, never an API).

stations.label: 03_YT_INDEX
stations.name: YT_INDEX
stations.description: Standard CKG argument-first index of each video (DeepSeek). Whole transcript per call.

stations.label: 04_YT_LENSES
stations.name: YT_LENSES
stations.description: Numbered focus lenses and lettered layers over indexed videos; --ask is free-text focus.

stations.label: 05_YT_CATALOG
stations.name: YT_CATALOG
stations.description: Channel overviews, debate pages, catalog.xlsx and catalog.sqlite from the index (local).

stations.label: 06_YT_WATCH
stations.name: YT_WATCH
stations.description: Automatic chain for channels in WATCH_CHANNELS: convert, clean, index, channel focus, catalog.

stations.label: 07_YT_CONVERT
stations.name: YT_CONVERT
stations.description: Convert SRT / VTT / JSON transcripts to ytgrab-style .md; originals kept in <Channel>/_originals (local).

stations.label: 08_YT_SUMMARY
stations.name: YT_SUMMARY
stations.description: Base layer for a video: the summary questions in QUESTIONS.md, whole transcript in one call.

stations.label: 09_YT_DEEP
stations.name: YT_DEEP
stations.description: Detailed, rigorous layer on top of the base summary (reads 08's output + the whole transcript).

stations.label: 10_CKG_THEOLOGY
stations.name: CKG_THEOLOGY
stations.description: Theology triage after the CKG index: 17 probes (CLEAN / NOTE / FLAG / CLAIM / ??), rules enforced in code, argument layer for the claim graph, YouTube platform notes.

stations.label: 11_CKG_PHYSICS
stations.name: CKG_PHYSICS
stations.description: Physics mirror pass after the CKG index: which physics process a theological event mirrors (or the reverse), stage by stage, in order, and whether it is identity, structural isomorphism or only analogy (rules enforced in code).

stations.label: 12_YT_TIDY
stations.name: YT_TIDY
stations.description: One uniform name (Ch 159 - Title) and an Obsidian note (front matter, H1, transcript) per transcript, into yt_markdown/<Channel>/, one for one; --watch waits for a download to finish, then converts, tidies and summarizes (local).

stations.label: 13_YT_CHANNEL_SUMMARY
stations.name: YT_CHANNEL_SUMMARY
stations.description: Channel summary folder: a 3-sentence summary, 2-3 keywords and the COLUMNS.md answers per video, one call each; the channel sheet (.xlsx, .tsv, index note) is rebuilt after every video.

stations.label: 14_STORY
stations.name: STORY
stations.description: Story Material System v1.0 (pilot): compact, traceable records for original writing (fast facts, human moments, connections, memorable lines, story devices, story spines). Its cards go at the bottom of the transcript page.

stations.label: 20_CKG_RUN
stations.name: CKG_RUN
stations.description: CKG atom run over ckg_root/INBOX (map, S01-S10, audit).

stations.label: 21_CKG_EXTRACT_CPE
stations.name: CKG_EXTRACT_CPE
stations.description: Split CKG outputs into claims / proofs / evidence (local).

stations.label: 22_CKG_INBOX_CHECK
stations.name: CKG_INBOX_CHECK
stations.description: Show what is waiting in the CKG inbox (no API).

stations.label: 23_CPEL
stations.name: CPEL
stations.description: Claims, Proofs, Evidence, Lean: four API calls per paper, in order, each its own folder under calls/ (switch any off in ckg.json).

stations.label: 24_CRAFT_PASS
stations.name: CRAFT_PASS
stations.description: Craft pass: per-section craft options carried as a loop (2 fundamentals + up to 3 extras, unused carried forward), memorable line, never-in-the-same-room analogy, then DeepSeek's best full version. Markdown (marked) + JSON. No HTML.

stations.label: 25_CKG_V4
stations.name: CKG_V4
stations.description: CKG V4 readable review: detailed synopsis, question ladder, every leg of the argument, the argument (who made it before, what is new, where it can go), claim discipline, evidence, paragraph walk, audit and build next. Eight calls per paper; YAML stays in the sidecar.

stations.label: 30_EVIDENCE_INTAKE
stations.name: EVIDENCE_INTAKE
stations.description: Evidence in one station: the intake companion (support, claims, predicates, standing) and the three dials (kind, claimed vs earned strength), 2 calls per paper.

stations.label: 31_EVIDENCE_MERGE_ORIGINALS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_MERGE_ORIGINALS
stations.description: Match companions to their originals by sha256 and merge (local).

stations.label: 32_EVIDENCE_BEST_ARGUMENTS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_BEST_ARGUMENTS
stations.description: Cluster primary arguments and weaknesses across companions (local TF-IDF).

stations.label: 33_EVIDENCE_BUILD_ONE_ARGUMENT
stations.name: EVIDENCE_BUILD_ONE_ARGUMENT
stations.description: Build one argument from a best-arguments cluster (lineage, originality, dimensions).

stations.label: 34_EVIDENCE_SERIES_SYNTHESIS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_SERIES_SYNTHESIS
stations.description: Grand synthesis master paper for one series.

stations.label: 35_EVIDENCE_SERIES_ARCS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_SERIES_ARCS
stations.description: Series scorecard, arc report and reorder recommendation.

stations.label: 36_EVIDENCE_THREE_DIALS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_THREE_DIALS
stations.description: Annotate one article with the three dials (kind, claimed vs earned strength).

stations.label: 37_EVIDENCE_SQLITE_SYNC
stations.name: EVIDENCE_SQLITE_SYNC
stations.description: Sync companions into the pipeline SQLite database (local).

stations.label: 38_EVIDENCE_SIDECARS
stations.name: EVIDENCE_SIDECARS
stations.description: Write / search evidence sidecars (local).

stations.label: 39_EVIDENCE_CHAIN_INTAKE_V2
stations.name: EVIDENCE_CHAIN_INTAKE_V2
stations.description: Epistemic intake v2: extract, evaluate against the rubric, adversarial synthesis (3 JSON calls).

stations.label: 40_ANALYTICAL_ARMS
stations.name: ANALYTICAL_ARMS
stations.description: Fruits (flagship) + master equation x2 + axiom nodes + coherence, always together (ANALYTICAL_ARMS_V1).

stations.label: 41_STORY
stations.name: STORY
stations.description: Hook / sequence / coherence per paper -> series pass -> gated memorable lines (STORY_STATION_V2).

stations.label: 42_STATISTICS_WALL
stations.name: STATISTICS_WALL
stations.description: Every academic + Obsidian metric in Python (same numbers every run), with corpus / series percentiles and change since last version.

stations.label: 43_PAPER_GRADER
stations.name: PAPER_GRADER
stations.description: Three local passes on each paper: paper_grader 0.2.0 (L15 atom analytics), the July paper-proof-grader, and advanced metrics (causal claims, hedges, idea density, concept drift, topic coherence, self-contradiction, Paper Metrics Engine). No API.

stations.label: 44_TAGGER
stations.name: TAGGER
stations.description: 20 tags scored 0-10 per paper and video; local pass first, DeepSeek confirms scores of 5+.

stations.label: 45_CLAIM_ATOMS
stations.name: CLAIM_ATOMS
stations.description: Atoms and axioms in one station: claim atoms and axiom-node mapping, 2 calls per paper.

stations.label: 46_REPORT_COMBINE
stations.name: REPORT_COMBINE
stations.description: Assemble every station's JSON in procedure order (aggregate.json/.md) and build report.html + report.xlsx.

stations.label: 47_NEW_PAPER
stations.name: NEW_PAPER
stations.description: Create the per-paper working folder from templates/PAPER_FOLDER (then tags it).

stations.label: 48_TOPIC_SYNTHESIS
stations.name: TOPIC_SYNTHESIS
stations.description: Bridge layer: best arguments for a topic across all papers, videos and evidence, cross-referenced, with citations; multi-page report.

stations.label: 49_GAP_MAP
stations.name: GAP_MAP
stations.description: Overlay a topic synthesis on David's own work: expand / contract / holes, and who said it first (citations).

stations.label: 50_LEAN_PAIR_AXIOMS
stations.name: LEAN_PAIR_AXIOMS
stations.description: Theophysics congruence matrix: evidence status x Lean status per paper (local).

stations.label: 51_LEAN_GOD_IS_UNPROVEN
stations.name: LEAN_GOD_IS_UNPROVEN
stations.description: Pair GOD IS unproven claims with Lean targets (local).

stations.label: 52_LEAN_ATOM_EXTRACTOR
stations.name: LEAN_ATOM_EXTRACTOR
stations.description: Lean atom extractor (scan / classify / verify / audit / enrich / export / pills / briefs / serve).

stations.label: 53_AXIOM_ONE_PAGE_TRANSFORM
stations.name: AXIOM_ONE_PAGE_TRANSFORM
stations.description: Transform axiom node pages into one-page form (local).

stations.label: 54_AXIOM_NODES_RUNNER
stations.name: AXIOM_NODES_RUNNER
stations.description: API_DEEP axiom-nodes runner over the atoms workspace (191-node registry).

stations.label: 55_LEAN_PAPERS
stations.name: LEAN_PAPERS
stations.description: Every Lean source in the Lean inbox (priority, series, general) -> formal paper, reader paper, claims in the claim template, a separate assumptions paper to review before running, and a theorem-to-claim reverse ledger; whole file per call, 30+ side by side.

stations.label: 56_TITLE
stations.name: TITLE
stations.description: Standard title + keywords + move (runs first; ~1.5k tokens a note)

stations.label: 57_API_DEEP
stations.name: API_DEEP
stations.description: Fruits, Axioms, Atoms, Lean, Stories, Master Equation, Coherence as one chain per paper

stations.label: 58_ARGUMENT_GRADE
stations.name: ARGUMENT_GRADE
stations.description: Strength and originality 0-8 per argument from quoted checks

stations.label: 59_CHI_EVALUATOR
stations.name: CHI_EVALUATOR
stations.description: chi-Evaluator v2 (pulled out of API 2): each claim scored on the Master Equation's ten channels, then four synthesized statements. 2 calls per claim, DeepSeek.

stations.label: 60_OPENAI_STATIONS
stations.name: OPENAI_STATIONS
stations.description: The 23 api_call_NN prompts, grouped into bundles so one whole-document call answers several.

stations.label: 61_SERIES_SHEET
stations.name: SERIES_SHEET
stations.description: Series sheet: every file of an evidence series in one run. One JSON and one markdown per file, one master HTML for the series. Local, no API.

stations.label: 62_ATOM_BUILDER
stations.name: ATOM_BUILDER
stations.description: ATOM BUILDER per paper: claim atoms (Claim, Evidence, Proof, Process + 10-section Atom Meaning Block, nerve-draft JSON for the Claim Atom Builder) and the axiom companion. 2 calls per paper.

stations.label: 63_PAPER_AUDIT
stations.name: PAPER_AUDIT
stations.description: One paper through the whole audit, in order: local grades (43), Paper Intelligence Suite (65), API Deep chain (57), argument grades (58), chi-Evaluator (59), statistics wall (42), combined report (46), then the series house and pages (64).

stations.label: 64_SITE_PACKAGE
stations.name: SITE_PACKAGE
stations.description: Files each audited paper into one house per series: a page per part (Markdown + HTML) with every audit result, the series title page rebuilt each time, an index of all series. Local, no API.

stations.label: 65_PAPER_INTELLIGENCE
stations.name: PAPER_INTELLIGENCE
stations.description: Theophysics Paper Intelligence Suite v2.0 (X:\THEOPHYSICS_PAPER_INTELLIGENCE): text analytics, academic standard, Theophysics metrics (chi, W/K, fruits, Master Equation variables, CKG tier), NLP deep, Truth Engine, emotion, linguistic depth, idea density, knowledge graph. Local, no API.

stations.label: 66_SORRY_AXIOM_AUDIT
stations.name: SORRY_AXIOM_AUDIT
stations.description: Every sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide in a Lean source, found in code first (free), then classified by one JSON call per file; remediation docket, blockers first.

stations.label: 67_LEAN_TRIAGE
stations.name: LEAN_TRIAGE
stations.description: Whole-corpus Lean triage: one compact JSON call per file — file kind, purpose, quality, duplicate hint, action; master 00_TRIAGE.md sorted by action.

stations.label: 68_FORMALIZE_TARGETS
stations.name: FORMALIZE_TARGETS
stations.description: One claim note in (canon docket, HOLD claims especially), one proposed Lean 4 statement out — always labelled PROPOSED; the compiler adjudicates later.

stations.label: 90_HEALTHCHECK
stations.name: HEALTHCHECK
stations.description: Every station, every path key, every API key; checks each declared option against the script's real --help.

stations.label: 91_RELOCATE
stations.name: RELOCATE
stations.description: After moving the folder: find every external path again (auto-search), confirm, save, health check.
